title: re-dispatcher execution request
description: Written by the active re-agent to /job/exec/requests/<name>.json (write a dot-prefixed temp name, then rename). The dispatcher imports executor.py, answers in /job/exec/results/<name>.json, and serves only this active job. Nothing outside these four properties is accepted: no env, mounts, devices, network, user, image, or privilege options.

job_id.description: A claimed job under /srv/re-lab/jobs/work with real (non-symlink) target/ and out/ directories. Its target/ (the originally submitted files) is copied, never mounted: at most 2 GiB, 10000 entries, depth 32, regular files and directories only (any link, device, fifo or socket rejects the request).

argv.description: Command vector run inside the image after the fixed flags. No shell. /job/in is a read-only, root-owned private copy of the job's target/; /job/out is a private writable scratch directory. After the run, regular files from /job/out are copied to work/<job_id>/out/<run_id>/ (at most 64 MiB; links and special files are skipped).

run_id.description: Per-request id (uuid4 hex). Output lands in work/<job_id>/out/<run_id>/.

output_skipped.description: Links, devices, fifos and sockets in the container's out/ that were not copied back.

output_truncated.description: The 64 MiB or 10000-entry cap stopped the copy-back.

output_error.description: A fixed message when the copy-back failed (for example a name already planted at the destination).

error.description: Present for rejected and error; a fixed message, never request content.
